svg.title: Weber: each of us has not one rank but three
svg.desc: Three cards. Class: people with a similar level of wealth and income, for example minimum-wage workers. Status group: people with the same prestige or lifestyle, for example the medical profession. Power: the ability to exercise one's will over others, for example corporate boards and government bodies. A banner notes that the three rankings often coincide but not always: a successful pickpocket may share an income class with a college professor, yet the thief holds low status.

text.font-family: Noto Sans, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: WEBER: EACH OF US HAS NOT ONE RANK BUT THREE
